'''Nilsson''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] record keeper of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

==Biography==
Sometime after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Nilsson was stationed in [[Mining Outpost (Dantooine)|Mining Outpost]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Here, he assisted several [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] with handling job records on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ImperialCorporalTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Lieutenant Nilsson]]
Nilsson was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. In the [[Star Wars video games|game]], players could talk to him to reset most quests on the planet of Dantooine, for one time only. After each server reset, Nilsson's appearance would change. However, he always appeared as a fair skinned, Human male.
